factors.operator: for each member i: lmax_i(z)=lmax_i0*exp(z); set gainprm[i,5]=biasprm[i,5]=lmax_i(z)
factors.semantics: changes MuJoCo built-in normalized lmax curve parameter; may affect active/passive curve evaluation; not optimal fiber length or tendon slack length
factors.v1_relationship: collectively replaces V1 common biarticular fpmax as primary structural role

known_limitations: fpmax is not measured tissue stiffness
factors.operator: rectus fpmax_i(z)=fpmax_i0*exp(z); hamstring fpmax_i(z)=fpmax_i0*exp(-z); synchronize gain/bias; other biarticular unchanged
factors.semantics: within-biarticular passive-force curve family balance; no global common scale
factors.v1_relationship: replaces V1 common biarticular fpmax primary role; V1 global factor removed

known_limitations: glmed3_r and piri_r anatomical action is multi-action/ambiguous
factors.operator: for each included member i: F0_i(z)=F0_i0*exp(z); synchronize gain/bias; all nonmembers unchanged
factors.semantics: MuJoCo muscle force scale F0 multiplies the built-in muscle active-plus-passive force expression; not pure active strength
factors.v1_relationship: replaces V1 hip-only fpmax primary role; V1 factor secondary only

membership_evidence.effect_sign_definition: unit positive muscle tension generalized effect = -projected actuator moment

membership_rule.ambiguous_rule: any threshold-borderline, sign-inconsistent, or non-negligible other-joint case is excluded and reported; no name-based override
membership_rule.antagonist_rule: monoarticular rule plus negative target sign in >=0.95 of effective states
membership_rule.biarticular_rule: hip and knee effective-state fractions each >=0.8
membership_rule.mechanical_quantity: actuator moment matrix projected through the independent-coordinate tangent; positive actuator force generalized effect in project q_hip/q_knee flexion coordinates
membership_rule.monoarticular_rule: target effective-state fraction >=0.8 and other-joint maximum absolute projected moment arm <=1e-6 m
membership_rule.near_zero_states: excluded from sign denominator when abs(target moment arm) < 1e-5 m
membership_rule.state_source: frozen V3 reference candidate MYOLEG_V3_K0312, beta=[0,0], 401 states
